verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of Penpot's export panel (formats, per-layer export presets, scales, slices); the only related evidence is a community report describing an inability to export a full document as PDF/JPG, only per-layer exports. Missing for 10: any docs on export formats, scale/suffix presets, or slice export from the vendor, and no evidence contradicting or confirming per-layer export granularity beyond one dated anecdote.
